assertions.assert: Every entry into `idle` (its start, and the end of each utterance, spoken or failed) sends `bot.ability.offers` `{ability: "speaking", choices: []}` to its parent: it offers nothing.

`bot.ability.speaking.input` `{text}` is encoded by the vocal child with the speaking's `provider`, `model`, `voice` and `media_type` (by default the original's gemini encoder, `audio/pcm`), written to `output_prefix` + the utterance's number + `.` + the media subtype (`media/speaking-<n>.pcm`), the text stripped first.

`playing` sends the efference copy `bot.ability.speaking.efference` `{mouth: "speaking", duration, media_type, sample_rate_hz, channels}` before the sound, `environment.sound` `{audio, media_type, sample_rate_hz, channels, source: "speaking"}` (its source the copy's mouth, so the listening can tell its own voice apart), to its parent; with no measured duration no copy is sent, and a rate or channel count the encoder leaves null is the speaking's own (24000 Hz mono).

`recording` sends `bot.ability.conversation.append` `{message}` to its parent, the outbound message `<conversation:message_for_turn>` builds (content the text, content_type `text/plain`, sequence 0, provenance id `speaking-<n>` and event `bot.ability.conversation.append`), then answers `bot.ability.speaking.output` `{text, media_type, sample_rate_hz, channels}` and returns to `idle`.

A blank text (after stripping) is refused before any encoding: `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "Speaking requires non-blank text."}`, and back to `idle`; an empty text never arrives: the input's schema refuses it at the send, raising `error.execution` in the sender.
A vocal failure (its `bot.ability.failed`) answers the parent with `bot.ability.failed` `{message}` carrying the vocal's message, and back to `idle`, where the next input is spoken.

Encoding is bounded by `encoding_timeout_ms` (30 s by default, decision D98; the original's 5 s is shorter than Gemini's unstreamed synthesis of a sentence): its timer answers `bot.ability.failed` `{message: "Speech encoding timed out."}` and returns to `idle`.
Input that arrives outside `idle` is held (`<event:defer/>`) and taken, in order, on the return to `idle`.
